combinations.reason: Remote rows are server-ordered; client row reorder cannot be committed as the authoritative data order.
Nested/group header geometry is not implemented by the current single-row header renderer.
Stable row keys are required and an edit session is finalized before its row leaves the rendered virtual range.
Variable row measurement is enabled only while expanded content is present.
Fixed offsets are recomputed from visible columns and hidden responsive columns contribute zero width.
Row reorder is temporarily unavailable while a projected sort/filter/search order is active.
Reorder cannot violate fixed-start / normal / fixed-end ordering.
Automatic responsive details would need a second row-details renderer and interaction owner; use explicit renderExpanded/details composition until that contract is implemented end-to-end.
